text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap was finally ready to take on the 
Senior Year. We came for the first shrine 
visit of the year to pray for a safe 
racing year, but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was just remembering. About the 
Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was over long ago... it 
just won't leave my mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's voices, the crackling heat in 
the air... Whether awake or asleep, I keep 
remembering that day.

I understand how Oguri Cap feels 
completely. With the fans' passion burning 
even hotter at the Arima Kinen, she must 
have felt something distinctly different 
from other races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I can run because of everyone who 
supports me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In the Arima Kinen, where everyone chooses 
who runs, I want to win. I want to keep on 
winning.
choice_data_list: Super Creek's waiting too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I need to become stronger.
choice_data_list: Shall we pray to the gods for that too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I hope they'll hear our request.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is there any other wish I should write on 
the wooden plaque?
choice_data_list:
Praying for good health: "A healthy horse 
is a great horse!"

Aiming for the strongest—"I'll become a 
monster!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Sounds like we're in for another 
series of back-to-back races, then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I should take care of my 
health. I see... my health...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...If I simply write 'eat lots of food,' 
would that not be foolproof?"

I told them that since they were already 
doing it, there was no need to 
deliberately write it down...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a monster, is it...? How intriguing. 
Still, I agree with that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If I become the strongest, will I no 
longer lose my way?"

There might be a chance, but I told them 
to rely on someone else for now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...When you say skills, do you mean 
like... being good at cooking?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... You meant that one.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I learn how to cook... I might 
be able to enjoy my meals even more than I 
do now.”

It's great that her capabilities are 
expanding, but along with that, I kinda 
wish she'd learn the art of not 
overeating...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, finished writing. Shall we head 
home?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...You here for Hatsumode too? Guess 
everyone's got things they wanna wish for.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Not me. I came here to make a 
declaration. —'The one standing at the top 
will be me!'"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that look? You gotta get 
fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It's no use. I...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the confidence... to truly 
fight Tama with everything I've got...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so stupid.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I truly believed... that Oguri saw me as 
her rival.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even though Oguri didn't think that way in 
the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, you... thought I was just 
some annoying little runt too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list:
...Are you sure you don't need to go after 
them?

...Are you sure you don't want to go after 
them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. Because... I can't say 
anything anyway.

After the year-end Arima Kinen, Tamamo 
Cross declared war on Oguri Cap. Ever 
since then, Oguri Cap has been acting 
strangely, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that I underestimated Tama. I 
knew all along that she was a rival I 
would one day have to face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Tama was so friendly with me... I 
was really happy.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Someone who could compete with me, 
understand my struggles, and run right 
alongside me... I'd never had a friend 
like that before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I might have been depending 
on Tama too much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When Tama was just looking for a serious 
match, I ended up acting so terribly 
towards her...

Oguri Cap had an overwhelming record back 
home. That's precisely why she might have 
felt a bit bewildered by a relationship 
that is both rival and best friend.
choice_data_list:
We need to clear up this misunderstanding 
properly.

We need to clear up this misunderstanding 
properly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

I recall the sight of those two close best 
friends. I'm sure they'll be just fine. 
With that belief in mind, I finished my 
New Year's shrine visit...
